subject.title: Telegram voice message delayed ~15 minutes before agent dispatch, then run aborts

question: What Telegram ingress-latency threshold, restart policy, and direct-chat aborted-turn fallback should OpenClaw guarantee for delayed voice messages?
rationale: The code gap is real, but changing watchdog restarts and visible failure replies affects Telegram delivery semantics and needs maintainer intent before automation chooses behavior.

options.title: Define narrow watchdog and fallback
options.body: Add source timestamp-to-dispatch measurement, maintainer-approved threshold/restart behavior, and a visible aborted/no-final response path with focused regression and live Telegram proof.

options.title: Land only the polling PR first
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86541 as a narrower liveness improvement while keeping this issue open for voice delay and no-reply behavior.

options.title: Wait for stronger live repro
options.body: Keep this issue blocked on redacted live Telegram logs or a reproducible Crabbox flow before choosing thresholds or fallback text.

recommendation.title: Define narrow watchdog and fallback
recommendation.body: Add source timestamp-to-dispatch measurement, maintainer-approved threshold/restart behavior, and a visible aborted/no-final response path with focused regression and live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: joshavant has recent adjacent ownership in isolated Telegram polling watchdog behavior, which is the central policy-sensitive surface for a latency restart decision.
